projects.name: Eleventh Round
projects.oneLiner: Career infrastructure platform for combat sports.
projects.description: Paid Buildora client engagement building a cinematic, Awwwards-quality career platform for fighters, managers, and promotions. Includes role-specific dashboards, a podcast section, and apparel integration.
projects.visualTheme: Cinematic combat sports — bold motion, high contrast, athlete energy

projects.name: VulnSwarm-VEX
projects.oneLiner: Deterministic dependency vulnerability triage with VEX verdicts.
projects.description: Turns OSV advisories into affected / not_affected / manual_review VEX-style verdicts using application-specific evidence. Uses Z3 for selected checks and keeps LLMs confined to reviewer notes. Paper under review.
projects.visualTheme: Dependency graph / network nodes — evidence flowing into verdict decisions

projects.name: Prompt Optimiser
projects.oneLiner: Production browser extension with a 6-stage AI pipeline.
projects.description: Chrome/Edge extension that transforms prompts through a 6-stage AI pipeline using Llama 3.3 70B via Groq. Injects real-time UI across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini interfaces.
projects.visualTheme: Browser extension / prompt transformation — flowing text, stage pipeline

projects.name: Adversary Emulation & Detection Lab
projects.oneLiner: Simulated attacks + custom detections across MITRE ATT&CK.
projects.description: Simulated 10+ MITRE ATT&CK techniques across Discovery, Persistence, Lateral Movement, and Collection on Windows and Linux. Collected telemetry with Wazuh and Elastic, then authored 10+ custom Sigma rules mapped to technique IDs.
projects.visualTheme: Security operations center — alerts, kill chain, detection coverage

projects.name: Acctomatic
projects.oneLiner: Agentic document automation for accounting firms.
projects.description: Agentic invoice ingestion and bookkeeping workflow automation. Extracts structured fields, flags uncertain items, generates review spreadsheets, and exports to accounting system formats using local VLMs and OCR.
projects.visualTheme: Documents / invoices — structured extraction, automation pipeline

projects.name: Crypton
projects.oneLiner: Zero-trust cryptographic identity and trusted-device auth.
projects.description: Leads technical direction for a zero-trust cryptographic identity platform built around trusted devices, challenge-response verification, device trust/revocation, and auditable access decisions. ~10 beta users.
projects.visualTheme: Cryptographic identity — keys, trust rings, device verification

projects.name: TinyVulnScanner
projects.oneLiner: Multithreaded Python scanner with 500+ concurrent ports.
projects.description: Lightweight vulnerability scanner combining fast port discovery, reflected XSS/SQLi checks, and structured HTML/JSON reporting.
projects.visualTheme: Port scan / radar — network sweep, open ports

projects.name: EDUAI
projects.oneLiner: AI study scheduler using Canvas LMS data.
projects.description: Ingested courses and tasks from Canvas LMS, then used predictive techniques to estimate effort and allocate daily/weekly study time.

projects.name: Proto Paper
projects.oneLiner: Turns research PDFs into runnable experiment guides.
projects.description: Full-stack hackathon tool that converts research PDFs into experiment guides, setup instructions, and runnable Python simulation code.
projects.visualTheme: Research / papers — PDF transformation, experiment pipeline

projects.name: BillShield
projects.oneLiner: Healthcare billing dispute and workflow automation.
projects.description: React product for healthcare billing disputes and AI-assisted patient communication workflows.
projects.visualTheme: Healthcare / billing — clean forms, dispute flow

projects.name: AI Outfit Recommender
projects.oneLiner: ML outfit recommendations from clothing attributes.
projects.description: ML system that recommends outfits from clothing attributes, occasion, season, and preferences.

projects.name: A Voice Made of Blinks
projects.oneLiner: Webcam blink interface for nonverbal ICU patients.
projects.description: Built with Claude Life Sciences hackathon. Real-time webcam blink detection drives a switch-scanning communication interface with per-patient calibration.
projects.visualTheme: Medical / accessibility — eye tracking, scan grid

projects.name: Buildora Agent Pipeline
projects.oneLiner: 12-agent LangGraph pipeline for lead gen and outreach.
projects.description: Replaced a no-code workflow with a 12-agent LangGraph pipeline for lead generation, site building, video pitch creation, and cold outreach. Connected to a real-time Next.js dashboard.
projects.visualTheme: Agents / pipeline — graph of autonomous workers
